Default review worktree resolution and removal both use absolute git-common-dir, so ownership remains stable across linked checkouts and review trees no longer sit under removable linked-checkout administrative directories. Existing legacy trees are deliberately preserved; upgrade failure guidance requires rescuing dirty files and unpushed commits before non-forced git worktree removal and retry, never deleting the parent first.
